assets.name: PointLight
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single game engine editor light-object icon, legible at 48 pixels, square canvas, truly transparent alpha background. Warm ivory and pale yellow lit center, thick dark brown outline, subtle bronze shaded border, clean polished slightly dimensional UI sprite. Centered isolated symbol occupying 80 percent of canvas with generous transparent margins. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no floor, no backdrop, no transform gizmo, no cursor, no cast shadow outside the symbol. Consistent crisp silhouette, simple forms, similar visual language to traditional 3D editor light sprites. Subject: one upright classic incandescent light bulb, rounded glowing cream glass bulb and short bronze screw base with three horizontal ridges, symmetrical front view.
